title: LiveAgentSandboxWorkerResult
description: live.agent-sandbox-worker-result@1 (Agent Streams S6): the answer to POST /api/streams/agent/:id/plays/worker (capability live.agent_sandbox.register). It carries the worker's state for the stream's owner as Live now holds it: whether a healthy worker is registered, the code and the owner-facing reason when not, when the last check-in was, and how long a check-in counts (a minute). Live never returns an endpoint: there is none to return.

code.description: Why there is no healthy worker; null when ready is true.

reason.description: The line the owner's page shows; null when ready is true.

last_seen_at.description: The last check-in, in milliseconds since the epoch; null when the worker never checked in.
